主要内容: Blonder Tongue Laboratories, Inc. (BLONDER TONGUE LABORATORIES INC) entered into a Third Amendment to Agreement of Sale on January 30, 2019, extending the closing date to February 1, 2019. The amendment required the Company to advance $130,000 to the Buyer at closing, representing a preliminary estimate of the Company’s share of property repairs at the Old Bridge Facility. The amendment was part of the Agreement, which included the Original Agreement, First Amendment, and Second Amendment. The description of the Third Amendment is qualified by reference to the document itself, filed as Exhibit 10.1. The filing also includes a 'Safe Harbor' statement regarding forward-looking statements, which are subject to risks and uncertainties. The amendment reflects changes to the terms of the sale agreement, impacting the Company’s financial obligations and operational plans.
